newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Educor buys Renwick, eyes more acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Educor buys Renwick, eyes more acquisitions.

text.p: The Education Investment Corp Ltd said on Tuesday that it had acquired Renwick Group (Pty) Ltd with effect from March 1 for 70 million rand.
The purchase price would be settled by the issue of 17.02 million shares of which 8.05 million had been placed with institutions at 435 cents a share and the balance would be held by the vendors.
The deal, which contained a profit warranty of five million rand after tax for the 1998 financial year, was subject to due diligence.
It said that talks on a further acquisition were also in progress and advised shareholders to exercise caution in their sharedealings until further notice.
"Educor's strategy is to acquire businesses which will contribute to long-term growth and lead to a mutually beneficial exchange and sharing of business opportunities," it said.
